check_groups.detail: Controller, tests and workflow match exact bytes, SHA256 and Git blob pins; wrapper pins equal manifest; source and wrapper parse as Python 3.9.

All six checked successor intent/result/lineage/fixture/old-host pins independently match actual retained native artifact; additional global predecessor and immutable runtime checks are required on host.
Exact inspect-supervisor-44945790158 operation, UUID schema, repository/branch/runner and first-attempt constraints; no caller command/path/run selection.
Ten fixed commands contain only systemctl show, rpm queries and fixed-unit journalctl; no service start/restart/stop, package installation, payload execution or browser call.
Only exact failed controller and public-browser supervisor journals, fixed 20:20:40–20:21:45 UTC window, 512-line limit, timestamp/unit/PID/comm/MESSAGE fields; no environment or command-line dumps.
ExecStart property is requested only for the newly created browser supervisor, never private/model services.
Fixed browser operation/unit/config bytes and metadata only; four private files are hash-only; no credential or private configuration content export.

Every ancestor opened through nofollow descriptors; regular bounded file reads use O_NONBLOCK, type/ownership checks where required and before/after identity checks; FIFO and symlink regressions pass.
Unchanged 90-second root timeout, 5-second kill grace, 100-second outer wait; all probe children remain in timeout process group; 512 MiB address space, 60 CPU seconds and 64 descriptors.

Eight required native tests before sudo; source hash rechecked before root compile, sanitized environment, bounded output captured by unprivileged runner; root probe does not write runner-selected files.
No failed record deletion or accepted fixture replay; exact package/private/runtime identities and remaining public episode paths are observed for the next explicit continuation.
Observations do not imply successful activation or automatic retry authorization; actual service failure cause and current state remain pending native probe.
